exposure: Neonatal admission to a neonatal unit
outcome: Frequency of gut colonization with Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP)
Frequency of skin colonization with bacteria
Bacterial typing by Enterobacterial Repetitive Intergenic Consensus (ERIC) PCR
cohort: The study included 30 neonates admitted to a 14-bedded neonatal unit of a tertiary care hospital in India.
finding: The study highlighted a high burden of blaNDM carrying CRKP colonization (33%) in neonates at admission, with 20% colonization pressure and multiple clones observed.
